extraFacts.fact: 316L is the low-carbon grade of 316 stainless steel; 316 contains molybdenum, which improves resistance to chlorides and pitting, so it is chosen for sea water, coastal plant and chloride-bearing process fluids.
extraFacts.source: ASTM A276 grade designations; Indus Hydraulics guide /blog/304-vs-316-stainless-steel-fittings

extraFacts.fact: Stainless steel threads can gall (seize and tear) when made up dry, so threads on stainless fittings are lubricated before assembly.

faqs.q: What are the Brennan N0304 IN Plugs used for?
faqs.a: The Brennan N0304 IN Plugs are hex-drive compression plugs that close the end of a tube fitting, made in 316 stainless steel with one brass row, in the Brennan Instrumentation series. The listing holds 12 part numbers for tube OD from 1/16 to 1.

faqs.q: How do I read part numbers such as N0304-08-SS and N0304-08-B?
faqs.a: The series is N0304, the two digits are the tube size and the suffix is the material: -SS is stainless steel and -B is brass. In the table N0304-08-SS is for 1/2 tube OD in 316 stainless, N0304-08-B is the 1/2 brass plug, N0304-16-SS is 1 tube OD and N0304-01-SS is 1/16.

faqs.q: What tube sizes do the Brennan N0304 IN Plugs cover?
faqs.a: The rows cover 1/16, 1/8, 3/16, 1/4, 5/16, 3/8, 1/2, 5/8, 3/4 and 1 tube OD in stainless steel, plus one brass row at 1/2. The part numbers run N0304-01-SS to N0304-16-SS, and N0304-14-SS is also listed as an instrumentation plug.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Brennan N0304 IN Plugs?
faqs.a: Match the plug to the tube OD of the fitting it closes, because the size code in the part number is the tube OD, so N0304-04-SS is for 1/4 tube. The listing names stainless tube as compatible and lists both imperial and metric measurement; confirm the make and size of your fitting with us before ordering.

faqs.q: What pressure do the Brennan N0304 IN Plugs hold?
faqs.a: The maker states 2,611 to 8,565 psi (180 to 591 bar) depending on size, and each row carries its own figure. For example N0304-02-SS is listed at 591 bar, N0304-04-SS at 277 bar and N0304-16-SS at 217 bar. Read the figure for your size, because the rating changes from row to row.

faqs.q: What material are the Brennan N0304 IN Plugs made from?
faqs.a: Most rows are 316 stainless steel, marked -SS, which suits corrosive process and instrument lines, and one row, N0304-08-B, is brass. The listing describes the finish as silver and the plug as corrosion resistant. Say which material you need, because the tube and fitting body should be a compatible material.

faqs.q: Which standards do the Brennan N0304 IN Plugs meet, and can I get certificates?
faqs.a: The listing is the Brennan Instrumentation series and states no separate standard. It holds no test certificate or declaration; if your job needs a material certificate, ask for it in the enquiry so it can be requested before supply.

faqs.q: What does the Brennan N0304 IN Plugs connect to?
faqs.a: The plug is a compression plug that closes a compression tube fitting of the same tube size; the listing names stainless tube and a tube hardness of RB 75 to 80 as compatible. For brass compression ranges see our [brass compression fittings shelf](/c/brass-compression-fittings).

faqs.q: How do I fit the Brennan N0304 IN Plugs?
faqs.a: Fit the plug into the compression fitting body and tighten the nut as the fitting maker directs, because the plug is cored and hex-driven. The listing notes that no thread sealant is pre-applied, so follow the fitting maker for any sealant. Do not mix makes unless we have confirmed they fit.

faqs.q: How do the stainless Brennan N0304 IN Plugs differ from the brass row?
faqs.a: Stainless rows such as N0304-08-SS suit corrosive service, while the brass row N0304-08-B is a 1/2 tube OD compression plug in brass for non-corrosive instrument and utility lines. Both are listed under N0304, so state the suffix, -SS or -B, when you order.

faqs.q: Where do the Brennan N0304 IN Plugs come from?
faqs.a: The listing gives Brennan as the brand and does not state an origin. We ship worldwide from Dubai, and the commercial documents for your order state the origin and the customs code that apply to the sizes you buy.

faqs.q: Are the Brennan N0304 IN Plugs in stock, and how do I get a quotation?
faqs.a: Yes, the Brennan N0304 IN Plugs is held in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need on [our contact page](/contact).
